value.description: Canonical JCS numeric value; either received zero sign is represented as +0. Actual received sign is retained in source_value_bits.

source_value_bits.description: Actual received finite IEEE754 binary64 value bits. For zero, source_row.value is canonical +0 and this field retains +0/-0; for nonzero, bits decode exactly to source_row.value. Bound by the package hash; exact received bits checked when original source is supplied.
